overview.description: The Canary Staked SUIS ETF (SUIS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long sui, short usd currency. The fund is a passively managed fund designed to provide 100% exposure to the price performance of spot SUI, with the potential for additional returns through staking rewards. The fund retains approximately 90% of staking rewards, net of fees. SUIS was launched on Feb 17, 2026 and is issued by Canary.

data.title: Canary Launches The First Spot SUI ETF, with Staking (SUIS)
data.text: BRENTWOOD, Tenn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)---- $SUIS #SUI--Canary Capital debuts its fifth crypto ETF with the Canary Staked SUI ETF available for investors on the Nasdaq.
